subject: [PATCH 40/60] mm/page_alloc: let MM callers select the local private zonelist

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new flag, ALLOC_ZONELIST_PRIVATE, which allows MM callers to select the local private zonelist independently of __GFP_THISNODE. This feature is designed to handle allocations for private memory, where no reserves are available to grant.
